name: Air-Cooled Chillers
title: Air Cooled Chiller Manufacturer, 0.5–15 TR | Win
description: Air-cooled water chillers with built-in tank and pump, 0.5 to 15 TR, made by Win Equipments, Coimbatore. No cooling tower needed. 1 TR from ₹55,000.
card: Packaged chillers that reject heat to air through condenser fans, so no cooling tower is needed.
lede: An air-cooled chiller rejects its heat to the surrounding air through finned condenser coils and fans, so it needs no cooling tower, condenser water pump or water treatment. We build packaged air-cooled water chillers from 0.5 to 15 TR with a built-in tank and pump, and larger units to order.

price.detail: 1 TR air-cooled WCP chiller: ₹55,000–₹78,000. 2 TR air-cooled chiller for injection moulding (WCP020): ₹85,000.

applications: Sites with poor water supply or no space for a cooling tower
applications_note: Air-cooled units suit plants where water is scarce or hard. In hot sites a water-cooled chiller with a cooling tower can use less power; see the comparison guide.
needs: Cooling load (TR or kcal/hr) or the machine to be cooled
Power supply: single or three phase

faqs.a: A chiller whose condenser is cooled by air from fans instead of water from a cooling tower. It needs no cooling tower, condenser pump or water treatment, which makes it simpler to install.

faqs.q: What sizes of air-cooled chiller do you make?
faqs.a: Packaged air-cooled water chillers from 0.5 to 15 TR with a built-in tank and pump. For example, our 1 TR unit is rated 3,000 kcal/hr and our 2 TR unit 6,200 kcal/hr. Larger units are built to order.

faqs.q: How much does an air-cooled chiller cost?
faqs.a: As listed on our IndiaMART store on 5 October 2026: a 1 TR air-cooled WCP chiller ₹55,000 to ₹78,000, and a 2 TR chiller for injection moulding ₹85,000. Your price depends on capacity, temperature and site conditions.

faqs.q: Air-cooled or water-cooled: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Air-cooled is simpler and needs no water; water-cooled with a cooling tower usually uses less power in hot climates and suits larger loads. Our guide on air-cooled vs water-cooled chillers compares them.
Yes. Our packaged air-cooled range starts at 0.5 TR. A portable single-phase mini chiller is listed on our IndiaMART store at ₹45,000 as of 5 October 2026. Send your duty for the right model.
